Cargo Plane Crashes in Miami, Killing Five

A cargo plane operated by Amazon crashed shortly after takeoff from Miami-Opa Locka Executive Airport, resulting in the deaths of five individuals and injuring five others. The aircraft experienced a "utter devastation" upon impact, with one report describing a van as "torn apart." Investigators have recovered the black boxes from the wreckage. The incident has prompted a debate regarding the necessity of buffer zones for airport runways.
